Description:
  Run tests on a server

Usage:
  altool runtests [options]

Options:
  --testgroups <testgroups>            JSON file with the test groups to run
  --project <project>                  Project folder
  --company <company>                  Company name
  --server <server>                    Server URL
  --serverinstance <serverinstance>    Server instance
  --port <port>                        Port
  --authentication <authentication>    Authentication type
  --tenant <tenant>                    Tenant
  --environmenttype <environmenttype>  Environment type
  -?, -h, --help                       Show help and usage information
